title: How it works
intro: CandidatAI organizes your job search, from the first job to the company's reply. Here's the journey, step by step; come back whenever you like.

who.title: Who does what

you.name: You
you.body: You decide which jobs move forward, review what gets prepared and confirm each application.

agent.name: Your agent
agent.body: The AI program installed on your computer, such as Claude Code or Codex. It reads jobs, explains whether they fit you and writes your CVs and cover letters.

app.name: The app
app.body: It stores your jobs and your profile, works out a 0-100 fit and fills in forms. On its own, it doesn't read jobs or write CVs.

who.promise: No application goes out without your confirmation, and your CVs only include what's in your profile.

prepare.title: Set up your search
prepare.body: Create your profile from your CV or start it by hand: everything written in your CVs comes from it. Then choose where to search. For the parts that need AI, have your agent installed.

collect.title: Gather jobs
collect.body: Paste a job's link or text in “{{newJob}}”, add your job alerts by email or press “{{searchJobs}}” in “{{home}}” so your agent goes through your job boards. New jobs from the companies you follow arrive by themselves. They all end up in “{{inbox}}”.

decide.title: Decide which are worth it
decide.body: In “{{home}}”, press “{{processJobs}}” and then “{{assessFit}}” (they appear when jobs are pending): your agent reads each job, the app gives it a 0-100 fit and your agent explains why it fits you or not. Then, in “{{triage}}”, approve or discard each one.

apply.title: Prepare and send the application
apply.body: Open an approved job and press “{{generateCv}}”: your agent writes a tailored CV and each line is checked against your profile. When you apply, the app can fill in the company's form and stops before sending: you review it and you confirm.

follow.title: Follow your processes and learn
follow.body: “{{processes}}” shows where each application stands and which have gone days without a reply. When a company replies, you note it on its job page. “{{calendar}}” gathers your interviews and other dates, “{{funnel}}” where your applications stall and “{{skills}}” what's being asked for that you don't have yet.
